opening.argument: Major banks suspending stock buybacks during the coronavirus outbreak is the subject of this CNBC business-news segment. It reports the announcement, identifies the Financial Services Forum, and explains the market context, including a potential effect on short sellers of bank stocks. The accompanying explanation describes buybacks as a way companies return capital to shareholders. These are features of financial reporting, not a request for viewers to send money, provide credentials, or join an investment scheme. The CNBC PRO and channel-subscribe prompts are ordinary media engagement references; the supplied record does not establish a deceptive financial offer or required participation flow.

citations.quote: Some of America's biggest banks announcing their suspending stock buybacks through the second quarter due to the coronavirus outbreak.
It will remove a potential hurdle for would-be short sellers of the bank stocks.
Buybacks are one way for companies to return capital to their shareholders and can help boost the price of stocks.
